readme.run: Motion-correct a two-photon calcium movie and extract ROIs, dF/F traces and spikes
notes: Input is a single-plane, single-channel TIFF or OME-TIFF movie (>= 20 frames).
Pass --frame-rate N if the TIFF metadata does not record the frame interval.
Choose --motion rigid (default), piecewise, or none. Add --help for every option.
No network connection is required and no external model files are downloaded.
Please cite Guizar-Sicairos et al. 2008, Pnevmatikakis & Giovannucci 2017 (NoRMCorre),
Pachitariu et al. 2017 (Suite2p), and Friedrich et al. 2017 (OASIS).
